title: Optical features dataset for Combustion State Recognition of a Furnace Based on Infrared Images: A Case Study
description: Optical features dataset accompanying the manuscript "Combustion State Recognition of a Furnace Based on Infrared Images: A Case Study", submitted to Case Studies in Thermal Engineering. Version 1.0.1 updates the manuscript title, target journal, and documentation from version 1.0.0; the data values are unchanged. Contains 37,265 records and 25 columns in all.csv. Features include flame area ratio, relative flame centroid position, and regional maximum and mean brightness. Existing partitions contain 26,096 training, 5,586 validation, and 5,583 test records. Source images and videos are not included.
